title: Show an annotation and its author to another participant
preconditions: Participant A and B have distinct Git identities and access to the same committed review.

steps.action: As A, place a rectangle with a distinctive comment and commit the review feedback.
steps.expected_result: The annotation is stored with review discussion context.

steps.action: Open the committed review as B and inspect the annotation discussion.
steps.expected_result: B can see the annotation and A's identity.

expected_result: B can see the annotation and A's identity.
